name: @talkasab/peruse
description: Lightweight local directory viewer: markdown, syntax highlighting, git-aware inline hunk diffs, live updates

scripts.build: bun build web/app.js --outdir dist --minify && cp web/index.html web/style.css node_modules/diff2html/bundles/css/diff2html.min.css node_modules/@catppuccin/palette/css/catppuccin.css dist/
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun test test/e2e/project-switcher.test.js && bun test test/e2e/core.test.js test/e2e/navigation.test.js test/e2e/sanitize.test.js
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
